# BearingBridge

> Eight specialist agencies that carry brands, products, and services across China and the West, both ways. Brand, channels, web, partner sourcing, content, sales. One ecosystem, one shared spine.

BearingBridge is the holding group (Beyond Border Group Ltd, Hong Kong) for a set of independent cross-border agencies. Each agency stands alone, and most clients start with one. Offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Paris, and Hangzhou, with representatives in the US, UK, Germany, and France.

## Agencies

- [TheChinaPath](https://thechinapath.com): Full-service China entry.
- [TheRedScroll](https://theredscroll.com): Chinese social media specialist.
- [ChinaWebFoundry](https://chinawebfoundry.com): Websites built for China.
- [Compass](https://compass.bearingbridge.com): Vetted China distributors and TPs.
- [BeyondBridge](https://beyondbridge.ai): Chinese brands, Western pipeline.
- [HubStudio](https://hubstudio.ai): Content production engine.
- [Nuvora Studio](https://nuvora.studio): LinkedIn-only B2B.
- [BearingBridge AI](https://www.bearingbridge.ai): AI adoption consulting, East and West.

## Languages

Available in English, French, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, and German. Localized paths use /fr/, /zh/, /es/, and /de/ prefixes.
